# Pine Design System — Full Reference

Single-file, machine-readable reference for the `pine-design-system` npm package. Covers installation, theming, every component's full prop table with defaults and usage guidance, and the foundation token scales. Structured tokens are also available separately as DTCG JSON at `https://pine-design-system.vercel.app/tokens/design-tokens.json`.

This file ships both at `https://pine-design-system.vercel.app/llms-full.txt` and inside the npm package as `node_modules/pine-design-system/llms-full.txt`.

## Overview

Pine Design System is a React UI component library with token-driven theming and accessibility built in. Components are built on `@base-ui/react` headless primitives, which handle markup, keyboard navigation, and screen-reader support — Pine applies only the token and style layer on top. Styling uses Vanilla Extract (zero-runtime CSS-in-TS).

Three design variants — `basic`, `game`, `crayon` — are switchable at runtime via a single `design` prop on `ThemeProvider`, without changing component usage code. Each variant supports both `light` and `dark` mode.

## Installation

```bash
npm install pine-design-system
# or: pnpm add pine-design-system
# or: yarn add pine-design-system
```

Requires React 18 or higher.

## Basic Usage

Wrap the app root with `ThemeProvider` and import the stylesheet once (importing `pine-design-system/style.css` is required; the `game` and `crayon` theme CSS is lazy-loaded automatically when `design` is set to those values).

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider, Button } from "pine-design-system";
import "pine-design-system/style.css";

export default function App() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultDesign="basic">
      <Button intent="primary">Click me</Button>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

### ThemeProvider props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `defaultDesign` | `"basic" \| "game" \| "crayon"` | `"basic"` | Initial design concept (uncontrolled). |
| `design` | `"basic" \| "game" \| "crayon"` | — | Design concept (controlled). Use with `onDesignChange`. |
| `defaultTheme` | `"light" \| "dark"` | — | Initial color mode (uncontrolled). |
| `theme` | `"light" \| "dark"` | — | Color mode (controlled). Use with `onThemeChange`. |
| `syncWithSystem` | `boolean` | `true` | Follows the OS color scheme when `theme` is uncontrolled. Set `false` to use `defaultTheme` instead. |
| `primaryColor` | `string` | — | Hex color (e.g. `"#6366f1"`) to override the primary palette at runtime. |
| `applyGlobal` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether to apply the theme class to `document.documentElement`. Set `false` when rendering multiple `ThemeProvider`s at once (e.g. side-by-side theme showcases). |

```tsx
<ThemeProvider design="game" defaultTheme="dark">
  {/* Game style + dark mode */}
</ThemeProvider>
```

Components never take a theme prop themselves — they read the active theme from context via an internal `useTheme()` hook.

## Foundation Tokens Summary

Full DTCG-format data: `https://pine-design-system.vercel.app/tokens/design-tokens.json`. Human-readable pages: `https://pine-design-system.vercel.app/foundation/colors`, `.../foundation/spacing`, `.../foundation/typography`, `.../foundation/radius`, `.../foundation/shadow`.

- **Spacing** (shared across all themes): `none`=0px, `xxxs`=2px, `xxs`=4px, `xs`=8px, `sm`=12px, `md`=16px, `lg`=24px, `xl`=32px, `xxl`=40px, `xxxl`=64px. Prefer these tokens over raw pixel values.
- **Radius** (shared across all themes): `none`=0px, `xxs`=2px, `xs`=4px, `sm`=6px, `md`=8px, `lg`=12px, `xl`=16px, `xxl`=24px, `xxxl`=32px, `full`=100%. Semantic radius tokens (`small`/`medium`/`large`/`xlarge`/`full` used by component props) map to different foundation steps per theme — e.g. semantic `medium` is foundation `xl` in the basic theme but foundation `none` in the game theme (game theme is square-cornered by design).
- **Shadow** (shared across all themes): `none`, `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` — soft elevation shadows. The game theme additionally uses a hard-edged `pixelBox` shadow instead of soft shadows for its pixel-art aesthetic.
- **Typography**: font families `sans` (Inter), `mono` (Roboto Mono), `crayon` (온글잎-승훈체), `pixel` (DungGeunMo, used by the game theme). Font sizes range `2xs`(0.625rem) to `5xl`(3rem). Font weights `thin`(100) to `black`(900); components expose `regular`/`medium`/`semibold`/`bold`.
- **Color intents**: `primary | secondary | success | warning | danger | neutral`, each with `surface` / `surfaceHover` / `surfaceActive` / `text` / `border` / `weak` sub-tokens. `primary` is user-customizable via `ThemeProvider`'s `primaryColor` prop; the rest are fixed per theme. The `game` theme derives its palette via a `toNeon()` saturation/lightness boost; the `crayon` theme via a `toPastel()` desaturation-toward-white adapter — both applied to the same foundation palette used by `basic`.

## Components

Import path for all components and tokens: `"pine-design-system"`.

---

### Badge

Inline component for status, labels, categories. Use next to text to convey supplementary information or list-item state.

```tsx
import { Badge } from "pine-design-system";

<Badge intent="primary">Primary</Badge>
<Badge intent="success" variant="outline">Success</Badge>
<Badge intent="warning" showDot>Warning</Badge>
<Badge intent="danger" variant="subtle">Danger</Badge>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"solid" \| "outline" \| "subtle" \| "weak"` | `"solid"` | `solid`: filled background, most emphasis — list status indicators, count badges near CTAs. `outline`: border only, medium emphasis. `subtle`: light background, low-emphasis supplementary info. `weak`: lightest background, low-contrast tags. |
| `size` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large" \| "xlarge"` | `"medium"` | Choose based on the size of adjacent text/components. |
| `intent` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "neutral"` | `"primary"` | Semantic color. |
| `rounded` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `"medium"` | Corner radius; `large` is pill-like. |
| `showDot` | `boolean` | `false` | Status dot before content. Recommended pairing: `success`↔online/normal, `danger`↔error/offline, `warning`↔pending/caution. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Required. Badge content. |

**Do**: use `solid` for the badge that needs the most emphasis on the screen. **Don't**: use multiple `solid`-variant badges in the same view — it makes it harder to tell which one matters.

---

### Button

Interactive component for user actions.

```tsx
import { Button } from "pine-design-system";

<Button variant="solid" intent="primary">Solid</Button>
<Button variant="outline" intent="primary">Outline</Button>
<Button variant="ghost" intent="primary">Ghost</Button>
<Button variant="weak" intent="primary">Weak</Button>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"solid" \| "outline" \| "ghost" \| "weak"` | `"solid"` | `solid`: the single most important CTA on screen. `weak`: secondary action paired with solid. `outline`/`ghost`: tertiary, low-emphasis actions. |
| `size` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large" \| "xlarge"` | `"medium"` | Choose based on context and required click area. |
| `intent` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "neutral"` | `"primary"` | For irreversible actions (delete, reset), always use `danger`. |
| `rounded` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `"medium"` | Corner radius; `large` is pill-like. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Fills the parent container's width. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Click events do not fire when disabled. |

**Do**: use a single `solid` button per view — multiple solid buttons make the primary action ambiguous. Set `type="submit"` explicitly when the Button should submit a form (unlike native `<button>`, this is not automatic here). **Don't**: use Button to render a link — style the `<a>` element directly instead.

---

### Checkbox

Selection control for choosing one or more options or agreeing to terms. Built on Base UI Checkbox.

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from "pine-design-system";

<Checkbox defaultChecked />
<Checkbox label="With label" />
<Checkbox label="Disabled" disabled />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large" \| "xlarge"` | `"medium"` | Choose based on adjacent text/form components. |
| `intent` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "neutral"` | `"primary"` | Semantic color. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Also required for screen readers to identify the checkbox's purpose. |
| `checked` | `boolean` | — | Controlled state — pair with `onCheckedChange`. |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | — | Uncontrolled initial state. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | — | |

**Do**: use `defaultChecked` when no external state is needed; switch to `checked` + `onCheckedChange` when integrating with form libraries or when other UI depends on the checked state.

---

### Dialog

Modal for important information or confirmation/input capture. Built on Base UI Dialog with focus trap, scroll lock, Escape-to-close by default.

```tsx
import { Dialog, Button } from "pine-design-system";

const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<Button intent="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Open Dialog</Button>
<Dialog
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  title="Dialog title"
  description="Dialog description text."
  size="small"
  actions={[
    { label: "Cancel", variant: "weak", intent: "neutral", onClick: () => setOpen(false) },
    { label: "Confirm", variant: "solid", intent: "primary", onClick: () => setOpen(false) },
  ]}
>
  <p>Dialog body content.</p>
</Dialog>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | — | Required. Dialog is always controlled. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | — | Fires on any close trigger (overlay, Escape, close button). |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | — | Fires specifically when the dialog closes. |
| `size` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large" \| "xlarge" \| "full"` | `"medium"` | `small`: simple confirm/cancel. `medium`: general forms/info. `large`: complex forms/detailed content. `xlarge`: content-heavy. `full`: full-screen. |
| `rounded` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `"medium"` | |
| `title` | `string` | — | Rendered as the accessible name. |
| `description` | `string` | — | |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Required. Dialog body. |
| `actions` | `DialogAction[]` | — | Footer action buttons; takes precedence over `footer` if both are set. |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` | — | Custom footer, used instead of `actions`. |
| `showCloseButton` | `boolean` | `true` | |
| `closeOnOverlayClick` | `boolean` | `true` | Set `false` for confirmation dialogs on irreversible actions, or when the dialog contains a form — prevents accidental dismissal / lost input. |
| `closeOnEscape` | `boolean` | `true` | |

`DialogAction`: `{ label: string; onClick: () => void; variant?: ButtonVariant; intent?: ButtonIntent; disabled?: boolean }`

**Do**: for irreversible actions (delete, reset), include a `danger`-intent action in `actions` and set `closeOnOverlayClick={false}`. Do the same (`closeOnOverlayClick={false}`) for any dialog containing a form, to avoid losing user input.

---

### Dropdown

Single-selection dropdown. Built on Base UI Select.

```tsx
import { Dropdown } from "pine-design-system";

const options = [
  { value: "a", label: "Option A" },
  { value: "b", label: "Option B" },
  { value: "c", label: "Option C" },
];

<Dropdown options={options} placeholder="Select an option" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | `DropdownOption[]` | — | Required. |
| `value` | `string` | — | Controlled selection — pair with `onValueChange`. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | — | Uncontrolled initial selection. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string \| null) => void` | — | |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `"Select an option"` | |
| `size` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `"medium"` | |
| `rounded` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `"medium"` | |
| `intent` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "neutral"` | `"primary"` | |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |

`DropdownOption`: `{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }`

**Do**: use Dropdown when there are 6+ options or space is limited. **Don't**: use Dropdown for 5 or fewer options where all choices should stay visible at once — use a Radio group instead.

---

### ProgressBar

Visualizes task completion (uploads, multi-step flows, background processing). Built on Base UI Progress; renders `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`/`min`/`max` wired automatically.

```tsx
import { ProgressBar } from "pine-design-system";

<ProgressBar value={72} label="Uploading" showValue />
<ProgressBar value={null} label="Loading…" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number \| null` | `null` | Number = determinate (measurable progress). `null` = indeterminate (unmeasurable); `aria-valuenow` is omitted. Avoid leaving a bar indeterminate indefinitely. |
| `min` | `number` | `0` | |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | |
| `size` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `"medium"` | Bar height. |
| `intent` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "neutral"` | `"primary"` | |
| `label` | `string` | — | **Required.** WAI-ARIA `progressbar` mandates an accessible name; also rendered as visible text. |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Displays the formatted value next to the label. |
| `formatValue` | `(value: number) => string` | — | Custom formatter for the displayed value and `aria-valuetext`. Keep it concise for screen readers. |

---

### Switch

Toggle for turning a setting or feature on/off immediately (no separate save step). Built on Base UI Switch.

```tsx
import { Switch } from "pine-design-system";

<Switch defaultChecked />
<Switch label="With label" defaultChecked />
<Switch label="Disabled" disabled />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large" \| "xlarge"` | `"medium"` | |
| `intent` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "neutral"` | `"primary"` | Color shown when on. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Always provide a label (this prop or an associated `<label>`) for screen readers. |
| `checked` | `boolean` | — | Controlled — pair with `onCheckedChange`. |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | — | |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | — | |

**Switch vs Checkbox**: use Switch when the change takes effect immediately with no save step, or for a single setting toggle. Use Checkbox when the choice is reflected on form submit, or for selecting multiple items from many options.

---

### Tab

Organizes related content into multiple panels. Built on Base UI Tabs.

```tsx
import { Tab } from "pine-design-system";

const tabs = [
  { value: "one", label: "Overview", content: <p>Overview panel content.</p> },
  { value: "two", label: "Details", content: <p>Details panel content.</p> },
  { value: "three", label: "Settings", content: <p>Settings panel content.</p> },
];

<Tab tabs={tabs} />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabs` | `TabItem[]` | — | Required. Keep to 2–6 tabs; for more, use a Dropdown or sidebar nav instead. |
| `value` | `string` | — | Controlled — pair with `onChange`. Use when syncing with URL params or triggering external actions on change. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | first tab's value | Uncontrolled initial tab. |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` | — | |
| `intent` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "neutral"` | `"primary"` | |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | `horizontal`: typical in-page tabs. `vertical`: sidebar-style navigation. |

`TabItem`: `{ value: string; label: ReactNode; content: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }`

---

### Text

Typography primitive for all text rendering; `as` (HTML element) and `size` (visual size) are independent.

```tsx
import { Text } from "pine-design-system";

<Text as="p" size="display-small" weight="bold">Display Small</Text>
<Text as="p" size="large">Large Regular</Text>
<Text as="p" size="medium">Medium Regular</Text>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `as` | `"h1"…"h6" \| "p" \| "span" \| "div" \| "label" \| "li" \| "ul" \| "ol"` | `"p"` | HTML element rendered, independent of `size`. |
| `size` | `"xsmall" \| "small" \| "medium" \| "large" \| "xlarge" \| "display-small" \| "display-medium" \| "display-large"` | `"medium"` | `medium` = default body text. `small`/`xsmall` = secondary text/captions. `large`/`xlarge` = subheadings/section titles. `display-*` = hero/page headings. |
| `weight` | `"regular" \| "medium" \| "semibold" \| "bold"` | `"regular"` | 400 / 500 / 600 / 700 respectively. |
| `intent` | `"inherit" \| "primary" \| "secondary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "neutral"` | `"inherit"` | `inherit` takes the parent's color. |
| `align` | `"left" \| "center" \| "right"` | `"left"` | |
| `truncate` | `boolean` | `false` | Ellipsis on overflow. |

**Do**: mix `as` and `size` independently to keep good semantic HTML while controlling visual weight, e.g. `<Text as="h2" size="large" weight="semibold">Section title</Text>` or `<Text as="label" size="small" weight="medium">Name</Text>`.

---

### TextField

Text input combining label, input area, and helper text in one component. Built on Base UI Field + Input. Set `multiline` to render a `<textarea>` instead of `<input>`.

```tsx
import { TextField } from "pine-design-system";

<TextField label="Name" placeholder="Enter your name" />
<TextField label="Email" placeholder="you@example.com" helperText="We'll never share your email." />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"outline" \| "filled"` | `"outline"` | `filled` distinguishes the field from other form elements. |
| `status` | `"default" \| "error" \| "success"` | `"default"` | `error`/`success` change border and helper-text color; pair with `helperText` for the message. |
| `size` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large" \| "xlarge"` | `"medium"` | |
| `rounded` | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `"medium"` | |
| `label` | `string` | — | |
| `helperText` | `string` | — | Renders as the error message when `status="error"`. |
| `multiline` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders `<textarea>` instead of `<input>`. |
| `rows` | `number` | `3` | Only used when `multiline` is `true`. |

**Do**: pair `status="error"` with a specific, actionable `helperText` message (e.g. "Please enter a valid email address") rather than a generic error label.

---

### Tooltip

Contextual hover/focus popup for supplementary, non-essential information. Built on Base UI Tooltip with ARIA wired automatically.

```tsx
import { Tooltip, Button } from "pine-design-system";

<Tooltip content="Save the document" side="top">
  <Button variant="outline" intent="neutral">Hover me</Button>
</Tooltip>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | `ReactNode` | — | Required. Do not place interactive elements (links, buttons) inside — keyboard users cannot reach them. |
| `children` | `ReactElement` | — | Required. Trigger element; must accept a `ref`. |
| `side` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "left" \| "right"` | `"top"` | Auto-flips when there is not enough space. |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | `"center"` | |
| `showArrow` | `boolean` | `true` | Not rendered in the `game` theme regardless of this value. |
| `open` | `boolean` | — | Controlled — pair with `onOpenChange`. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | — | |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | — | |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Tooltip does not render at all. |

**When to use vs. alternatives**: label an icon-only button → Tooltip. Show a keyboard shortcut → Tooltip. Field hints → `TextField`'s `helperText`, not Tooltip. Confirm a destructive action → `Dialog`, not Tooltip. Form validation errors → `TextField`'s `status` + `helperText`, not Tooltip.

#### TooltipProvider

Wraps a region (or the app) so multiple tooltips share one hover-delay timer — after the first opens, subsequent ones open instantly. Common in toolbars.

```tsx
import { TooltipProvider, Tooltip, Button } from "pine-design-system";

<TooltipProvider delay={600} closeDelay={300}>
  <Tooltip content="Bold"><Button>B</Button></Tooltip>
  <Tooltip content="Italic"><Button>I</Button></Tooltip>
  <Tooltip content="Underline"><Button>U</Button></Tooltip>
</TooltipProvider>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | One or more `Tooltip` components. |
| `delay` | `number` | — | Hover-open delay (ms) shared by all wrapped tooltips. |
| `closeDelay` | `number` | — | Close delay (ms) after cursor leaves, shared by all wrapped tooltips. |
